eps.ov: Koro Sensei and his students try some matchmaking at the end of their island trip. Class 3-E's eventful summer ends with a taste of pure festival fun.
eps.oa: يحاول «كورو سينسي» وطلابه التوفيق بين قلبين في نهاية رحلتهم إلى الجزيرة، وينتهي صيف الصف 3-E الحافل بنكهة خالصة من متعة المهرجان.

eps.ov: Kaede comes up with a delicious plan of attack, Class 3-E plays an intense game of Cops and Robbers, and Koro Sensei is accused of a serious crime.
eps.oa: تبتكر «كايدي» خطة هجوم شهية، ويلعب الصف 3-E لعبة «الشرطة واللصوص» حامية، ويُتهم «كورو سينسي» بجريمة خطيرة.

eps.ov: Koro Sensei faces off against the powerful, tentacled Itona and his handler Shiro yet again, revealing more of his teaching philosophy along the way.
eps.oa: يواجه «كورو سينسي» مرة أخرى «إيتونا» القوي ذا المجسات ومشرفه «شيرو»، كاشفاً في أثناء ذلك المزيد من فلسفته في التعليم.

eps.ov: Itona endears himself to the boys in Class 3-E as he shows off his assassination creation. The students call each other code names for an entire day.
eps.oa: يكسب «إيتونا» مودة فتيان «الصف 3-E» وهو يستعرض ابتكاره للاغتيال. ويتنادى الطلاب بأسماء رمزية يوماً كاملاً.

eps.ov: Competition between the elite A Class and downtrodden E Class heats up at the school sports festival, with Isogai's livelihood hanging in the balance.
eps.oa: يشتد التنافس بين صف A النخبوي والصف E المستضعف في المهرجان الرياضي للمدرسة، ورزق «إيسوغاي» على المحك.

eps.ov: After an accident, the E Class winds up doing a whole different kind of studying off campus. But will they have a chance to bone up for the midterms?
eps.oa: بعد حادث ينتهي الأمر بالصف E إلى دراسة من نوع مختلف تماماً خارج المدرسة. فهل ستسنح لهم فرصة للاستعداد لاختبارات منتصف الفصل؟

eps.ov: A well-intentioned act leads to a falling-out with Professor Bitch. Soon the E Class finds itself facing off alone against a formidable assassin foe.
eps.oa: يفضي تصرف حسن النية إلى خلاف مع الأستاذة «إيرينا». وسرعان ما يجد الصف E نفسه وحيداً في مواجهة قاتل مأجور مهيب.

eps.ov: When Koro Sensei and Mr. Karasuma reach the Reaper's hideout, it's anyone's guess who'll come out on top--especially with wild-card Irina in the mix.
eps.oa: حين يصل «كورو سينسي» والأستاذ «كاراسوما» إلى مخبأ «الحاصد»، لا يدري أحد من سيخرج منتصراً، ولا سيما مع «إيرينا» التي لا يُعرف في أي صف ستقف.

eps.ov: The students consider their future career options. Nagisa struggles to come to terms with his talent; meanwhile, his mother has her own plans for him.
eps.oa: يفكر الطلاب في خياراتهم المهنية المستقبلية. ويجاهد «ناغيسا» ليتقبل موهبته، بينما لأمه خططها الخاصة له.

eps.ov: Each class at Kunugigaoka Academy is competing for the highest sales totals in the school festival. How can the E Class even hope to stand a chance?
eps.oa: يتنافس كل صف في أكاديمية «كونوغيغاوكا» على أعلى مبيعات في مهرجان المدرسة. فكيف يأمل الصف E أن تكون له أي فرصة؟

eps.ov: It's exam time again, and the cream-of-the-crop A Class is a bigger threat than ever before. Top-ranking Asano, however, has something up his sleeve.
eps.ta: وقت اختبارات نهاية الفصل، الحصة الثانية
eps.oa: حان وقت الاختبارات من جديد، وصف النخبة A أشد خطراً من أي وقت مضى. لكن «أسانو» صاحب المرتبة الأولى يخبئ شيئاً في جعبته.

eps.ov: The end-of-term exams come down to one doozy of a final problem. Principal Asano comes to Koro Sensei with a little wager that has a lot riding on it.
eps.oa: تنتهي اختبارات نهاية الفصل إلى مسألة أخيرة عويصة. ويأتي المدير «أسانو» إلى «كورو سينسي» بتحدٍّ صغير يضع على المحك الكثير.

eps.ov: Principal Asano recalls his first foray into the world of education. In the drama festival, the E Class puts on a play with a few unexpected twists.
Following the drama festival, the E Class learn that one of their classmates is hiding a big secret connected to Koro Sensei's past!
Koro Sensei begins to come clean about his background after a tense and terrifying encounter with a student who has her own reasons to kill him.

Following the traumatic story of Koro Sensei's past, the E Class is left reeling after learning revelations about his past deeds and identity. As the gather themselves with this new information, it begins to affect their assassination plans.
The E class is divided over whether to kill Koro Sensei or try to save him. Koro Sensei suggests a way of settling the issue between the two sides.
The battle amongst the E-Class comes down to the final two on each side: Karma vs. Nagisa. But, a new obstacle throws a wrench into the E Class's plans.
Class 3-E has agreed to try and save Koro Sensei. In order to do this, they must track down confidential information -- information that takes the class to another height.
Nagisa remains uncertain about his future as high-school entrance exams loom over him. It's time for Class 3-E to celebrate Valentine's Day!
It's time for the last project from Koro Sensei before the E-Class closes out the year, but the government's own plans and threatens to get in the way.
The students fight to see their teacher one last time. A figure from Koro Sensei's past arrives with a serious grudge against the super-creature.
A pitched battle between two super-creatures threatens to harm the students of Class 3-E. Can Koro Sensei protect them while fighting for his life?
Time is running out, and the E Class students must decide once and for all whether to kill the teacher who so changed their lives over the past year.
Graduation day: one of life's chapters ends and another begins as the students and teachers of Class 3-E go on to forge their own paths in the world.
